lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Clerk 1147-F. Shift 7. Your scheduled mortality date has passed. You continue to process cases.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Three cases. The first is from Jun Vale — officially deceased, active on Route 7-B.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: He knows I verified the manifest.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Case two: Quiet Choir petition. 847 signatures. Fourteen forged. Statute 8-F applies.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: They told me about the forgeries in the message.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Case three: final packet from VC-0442-M. Section 19.4 incineration — immediate.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Jun Vale case resolved. Meeting coordinates logged or suppressed per your action.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: He is on the train. Officially dead. Writing from carriage 3.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Two cases remain. The petition will test your compliance index.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: Memory deletion. Not physical death. Calyx signed it in 2142. Entropy 0.67.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Trial termination analysis is not a standard clerk function.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: 847 living-dead beneath the sealed district. My brother is one of them. I need to go down.
